policies.geometry: Room visual coordinates 120x80; projection 100x100 mapped to ST.PROJECTION [38,2,114,25]. All V/C/H/A and physical commits remain Item 05/09. Padding never expands collision or hit regions. Puppet bindings explicitly store initial projection placementOrigin and offset logicalBounds, including Pip/Grandma reach padding; this preserves Item09's owner-relative AssetUse convention. MODEL uses its own model-local map.
policies.padding: Raster props/actors: 4 base pixels transparent padding on each edge, 8 at 2x. Backgrounds and source stills: no padding. logicalBounds fit the content rectangle; inflate destination image bounds by padding/content scale. AssetUse.anchor is normalized in the whole padded image. Trim metadata and foot anchors cannot change between variants.
policies.masters: Original layered reconstruction guided by current generated references. Master directory contains separately editable high-density PNG layers per variant plus alignment/author/source notes. At least twice base dimensions; keep source layers before export. No claim that upscaling the 1536px reference adds detail. Flatten only a single asset variant at export.
policies.export: Base and 2x are alternatives, never simultaneously decoded for one slot. Padded alpha PNG for figures/props; opaque WebP with same-size PNG fallback for rooms. Files named assets/<asset-id lower-case with hyphens>/<variant>@1x|2x.<format>. Source layers under masters/<asset-id>/. These paths are future relative game paths, not existing files.
policies.input: Hit testing uses Item 05 object geometry and Item 09 native targets (minimum 48 CSS px), never opaque pixel shape or alpha. PUP/MODEL scenery is read-only; only the model tab operates the model. DOM controls hold focus; no movement while typing.
policies.text: CT references are rendered native readable text, never generative lettering. Segoe UI Regular/Bold, Arial, sans-serif by installed font name; no redistributed font binary. 100/125/150% text and roomier leading; compact Arrange/Watch keep whole room/both banks.
policies.exposure: Having an export decoded in private memory is not exposure. Paint/mount only eligible components; hidden bodies/captions absent from accessible tree and previews. Failed artwork is not recorded as seen; actually presented equivalent descriptions are recorded. No reading or understanding credited for owning the caddy.
policies.missing: Missing informative art: CT.TECH.ART_ERROR, retry or existing named actions/descriptions. Keep actual state and legal routes. Use each asset's specified temporary equivalent during development, clearly marked in review; do not report final visual acceptance. No automatic help/solution.
policies.animation: Clips present Item 09 operations only. Actor approach before manipulation. Cue key runId:index commits once at endpoint; controlled interruption settles active cue once then pauses before next. Never run logical completion from an image/audio callback. Hard close restores last acknowledged boundary with history uncertainty.
policies.quality: Current rich cast and four room paintings govern finish: expressive faces, clothing folds, painted wood, paper cut edges, warm upper-left light and coherent depth. Functional SVGs govern only layout and state. White Jo with fair skin, dark-brown twin buns, coral shirt, teal overalls.
policies.rights: No new third-party assets proposed. User reference ownership/license and generation model version are undocumented; do not assert exclusivity/blanket clearance. Future creator records and distribution review accompany actual production. Original runtime shapes and future authored effects use their own recorded source; no stock icon pack or font extraction.
policies.status: referenceAvailable / requirementsDefined / productionFileExists / exportChecked / visualReview / runtimeChecked are separate. This manifest defines production; all future production files have exists=false, bytes=null, sha256=null. Reference visual inspection is not production review.
policies.layering: rear wall/floor > bounded projection > ground contact shadows > furniture and world figures sorted by ground feet > contained foreground lips > DOM controls/focus/captions. Projected paper shadows remain inside story. Avoid new full-room foreground alpha images.
policies.caching: Initial load base density only, current room/shared assets; no E2 or audio blocking start. High density on demand when detail available. Adjacent base room art may prefetch after current usable; cache eviction by decoded bytes; never retain all high-density room sets. No 2x allocation for compact overview alone.
policies.inheritance: For an asset, representation selects profiles.raster/native/audio. Missing production/availability/temporary/geometry shared fields inherit that profile; explicit asset fields replace the corresponding field, arrays replace rather than append. Planned export availability/bytes/hash remain explicit per file. Reverse UI/transition references are derived via stateCoverage/transitionCoverage, not duplicated on assets. State assetIds name eligible components; visibleWhen still controls actual painting. bindings contain exact owner/role/anchor/criticality. Reference metadata inherits referenceProfiles[kind], never assumes production readiness from file existence. CASE is a nonspatial composition-root alias resolving to this manifest's caseId, not a new world entity. Shared shadow/foreground/focus bindings dispatch to actual current owner instances; ground shadows draw beneath them, clipped lips above their contained contents, and focus in DOM. AssetUse.role classifies the resource; geometry.layer specifies its draw pass.
